hook_text: A person can live for weeks without food, but only a few days without water.
clip_script: A village near Giyani in Limpopo. Before school, Tsakani carries water from the communal tap. Her grandmother picks spinach from the garden and cooks maize meal porridge. At night the family sleeps safe and dry in their house. Water, food and shelter. Every person on Earth needs them, in a farm, a village, a town or a city. What changes from place to place is how people get them.
visual_style: Whiteboard drawing of a water drop, a plate of food and a house, each linked by arrows to a village and a city.
pacing: One need at a time with a village example and a city example, then the big idea.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and list where your family gets its water, food and shelter.
